mapper.insert: insert into emotion_diary (user_id, diary_date, mood_score, dominant_emotion, emotion_triggers, diary_content, sleep_quality, stress_level, ai_emotion_analysis, ai_analysis_updated_at, created_at, updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{diaryDate}, #{moodScore}, #{dominantEmotion}, #{emotionTriggers}, #{diaryContent}, #{sleepQuality}, #{stressLevel}, null, null, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) on duplicate key update mood_score = values(mood_score), dominant_emotion = values(dominant_emotion), emotion_triggers = values(emotion_triggers), diary_content = values(diary_content), sleep_quality = values(sleep_quality), stress_level = values(stress_level), ai_emotion_analysis = null, ai_analysis_updated_at = null, updated_at = values(updated_at), id = last_insert_id(id)
mapper.select: select d.* from emotion_diary d join ai_analysis_task t on t.diary_id = d.id where t.id = #{taskId} and t.status = 'PROCESSING'
